label: v4 swap client
summary: Plan a reviewed v4 quote and swap client with executable hooked quotes, explicit router generation and per-hop parity.
requiredFacts: Exact v4 SDK, SDK Core, Universal Router SDK package versions, integrities, release gitHeads and package-root imports
Exact chain deployment bindings for Universal Router, Permit2, StateView, V4Quoter and every PoolKey
Executable hooked quote source with identical PoolKey, hookData, sender assumptions and coherent block context
Explicit Universal Router generation, V4_SWAP actions, settlement, native value, Permit2, deadline and final-delta bounds
Per-hop hookData mode, minHopPriceX36 behavior and SDK 2.3 output-loss slippage semantics
Exact-output full-fill enforcement at every hop, including repeated-currency multihop routes whose intermediate delta can net away
Bounded decoding for every router static head, dynamic offset, array length, multiplication and short selector before any read or action
PoolManager callback-caller and Universal Router callback-sender authentication for every signedRouteContext consumer
Pre-signature decoding and exact simulation of target, calldata, value, chain, account, recipient, Permit2 scope and deadline
requiredFiles: Quote and route-construction source using public package-root imports
requiredTests: Hooked quotes fail without V4Quoter or the reviewed executable simulation and never fall back to local Pool math
Explicit router generation and exact action ABI for every supported direction and exact-input or exact-output mode
Single-hop and multi-hop hookData byte parity, mixed hooked routes and one minHopPriceX36 value per pool
Exact-output full fill or revert at every hop, repeated-currency intermediate underfill, final minimum output, maximum input, partial fills and hook deltas
Malformed, truncated, overlapping, out-of-range and length-overflow command bytes fail before load, copy, dispatch, approval or transfer
PoolManager and Universal Router signed-route identities each fail independently when mismatched
Deadlines, native value, Permit2 and refunds
Stale state, reorg, changed hookData, unsupported route, quote revert and provider or deployment outage
Wrong chain or account, untrusted spender or calldata, signature replay or expiry, transaction replacement, reverted receipt and final-balance mismatch
risks: Local no-hook pool math can misquote any route whose hook has swap permissions
An omitted router generation can silently fall back to V2_0 and lose the intended action ABI
Convenience multi-hop encoding can replace required per-hop hookData with empty bytes
Final PoolManager currency netting can hide an exact-output underfill when a currency repeats across hops
A router and a sibling periphery head in one registry are not proof that the router embeds that periphery fix
Single-identity signedRouteContext validation can confuse PoolManager callback authority with router route authority
